rationale: Base rate 0.06 (Democrats 0 of ~12 Texas Senate races since 1990 times ~0.9 Michigan Democratic hold rate). Strong polling evidence moves this up a lot: Texas polls in October have Talarico tied to +3 over Paxton (Fox tie, Marist +2, UT +3), and El-Sayed leads Rogers by about 2-4 in averages with Cook rating it a Toss-Up. Roughly 0.5 x 0.7 with positive correlation in a Democratic-leaning year gives about 0.40. A search result quoted market odds for Michigan; I discarded it.

Base rate 0.90 (Democrats won about 10 of the last 11 Minnesota Senate races). Flanagan leads Tafoya by 3-5 points in averages and the national environment favors Democrats, but Cook moved the race from Likely D to Lean D over the fraud scandal and undecideds are high. Small move down to 0.84.

Base rate 0.04 (ECB hikes at a given meeting while on hold are rare, about 100 meetings). Reuters poll: 70 of 73 economists expect a hold at 2.50% on Oct 29, with a December hike expected; Bloomberg survey agrees. Stay at 0.04. One result quoted a prediction-market figure; I discarded it.

Base rate 0.80 for an existing lull holding three more weeks (few comparable cases). No direct Israel-Iran strikes on territory reported since about July/August, and Trump has ruled out strikes before the Nov 3 midterms, but Time/NYT report US and Israel planning major strikes after the midterms and Netanyahu pushed for a renewed offensive; the window runs 12 days past the election. Down to 0.65.

Base rate 0.97 (Republicans have won every South Carolina Senate race for decades). Strong evidence of a close race: the Republican nominee is Darline Graham after Lindsey Graham's death, aggregates show Graham up only about 2, and Cook moved it to Lean R. The state's lean still favors Republicans, so 0.76. A result quoted market prices; I discarded them.

Base rate 0.25 (Democrats won 2 of the last 9 Ohio governor races). Strong polling evidence: Acton leads Ramaswamy in Marist (+7), BGSU (+6), Cook (+5), Fox (+2), averages Acton +2.6 to +4.7, and Sabato moved it to Lean D. Ohio's R lean and polling error risk keep it at 0.66. A result quoted market prices; I discarded them.

Base rate 0.70 (party holding 53 seats, adjusted for the usual midterm losses by the president's party). Strong evidence against: Nate Silver's model gives Democrats 75%, Vote-Scope 71%, Cook shows Democrats competitive in Texas, Alaska, Ohio, South Carolina, Kansas and Mississippi. Down to 0.28.

Base rate 0.02 for a general Russia-Ukraine ceasefire in a 5-day window. Only a local Oleshky humanitarian ceasefire was agreed (which does not qualify), the Kremlin says it will not slow its offensive, and the next talks are planned for mid-November. Stay at 0.02.

Base rate 0.87 (incumbent senator re-election rate). Strong evidence against: Peltola leads in averages by about 1-2.5 points (NYT/Siena +7, PPP +1, ASR final-round +2) in a Democratic-leaning year, though Alaska's R lean and polling misses there keep it close. 0.43. A result quoted market prices; I discarded them.

Base rate 0.10 for a specific rumored model launching within a given 5-day window. Leaks (partner access, an Azure/LiteLLM identifier on Oct 13, 'next week' claims around Oct 13-19) raise it, but those predicted dates have already passed without a launch and no official statement exists as of Oct 25. Up to 0.20.

Question resolves YES if no US-Iran Hormuz agreement is announced by Nov 2. Base rate 0.93 that a specific diplomatic deal does not happen within a week. Indirect talks continue via Pakistan and Qatar and Araghchi claims US acceptance of a 7-day proposal, but Trump denies talks, Iran says the strait stays closed until its conditions are met, and the sides disagree on whether nuclear issues are included. 0.92.

Base rate 0.03 for a formal ceasefire announcement within 5 days during active fighting. Israel Hayom reports a Saudi defense minister visit to Tehran and a $1B offer to halt attacks, and there are reports of a Houthi truce offer, but Riyadh officially rejects a new ceasefire and a Saudi-backed ground offensive is ongoing. Small move up to 0.06.
